turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jordan calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Cindy Andrews?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. can't I also confirm the email we have on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, that's still the right one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $92.20.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. I got laid off last month.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Some of these charges aren't mine. I think it's fraud.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I'll note that on the file and have it reviewed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's a hard time.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to make a complaint about how many times you call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a note on the file so the hardship team can review your situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should hear from them within a few business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay $10 Oct 16.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $10.00 on October 16. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
